title: Ancient Egypt: The Oldest Resurrection Story
description: Osiris, Isis and the oldest story of coming back to life.

lines.en: He died and rose again. This is not a new story. It is the oldest tale of coming back to life known to humanity.
Osiris was a great king. His brother Seth betrayed him, cut his body into pieces, and scattered them across Egypt.
His wife Isis traveled the world to gather his body parts and brought him back to life with her magic, making him the god of rebirth and the afterlife.
People even made small clay figures filled with seeds to show life returning from death.
The fight between his son Horus and his brother Seth was more than a battle. It brought order and justice back to the whole universe.
The pharaohs were seen as Horus while alive, and as Osiris after death, to secure their place in eternity.
This story was written on pyramid walls over four thousand years ago to show every Egyptian that death is not the end.
He died, was torn apart, and rose again. It was just the start of a new journey, and temple walls still tell his story today.
Why do you think the ancient Egyptians were so focused on the idea that death is not the end of the road?
